You can return products within 30 days of purchase for store credit or a refund to your original payment method. Please note that shipping charges are non-refundable, and live bees are non-refundable (except in cases of end-of-season stock shortages).
Items included in a kit are refunded at retail minus 10%. Once processed, refunds generally take 3 to 10 days to appear on your statement.
